Apply after the existing schema to retain encrypted dependency-key custody. Keep the generated installation key private and include it in recovery custody.

Apply migrations/core/0071_blind_project_requests.sql after the existing migrations, including 0070_analytics_portfolio_revision.sql. Preserve all previously applied migration names and bytes. This adds durable blind project-request intake without replaying it from archives.

Apply migrations/core/0082_portfolio_capacity.sql after 0081_rule_audit_correlations.sql and all existing migrations. This adds human-reviewed portfolio capacity application and undo records. Preserve all previously applied migration names and bytes.

Apply migrations/core/0083_guest_share_reviews.sql after 0082_portfolio_capacity.sql and all existing migrations. This adds exact initial guest-share reviews and retained decisions. Preserve all previously applied migration names and bytes.

Apply migrations/core/0087_search_and_bulk_selection.sql after 0086_approval_followup_cancellation.sql and all existing migrations. Preserve previously applied migration names and bytes. This adds private saved search filters and reviewed bulk-selection receipts.

Apply migrations/core/0092_archive_calendar_provenance.sql after 0091_intake_source_evidence.sql and all existing migrations. Preserve all previously applied migration names and bytes. Calendar connections and blocks retain inactive archive provenance without resuming provider operations.

Apply migrations/core/0093_personal_rule_archive.sql after 0092_archive_calendar_provenance.sql. Preserve all previously applied migration names and bytes. Restored personal section rules require their own person to activate them explicitly.
